nodes.description: Internal transfer routine that enforces open-trading, blacklist, max-tx and max-wallet limits, executes the fee-on-transfer swap and takes the buy/sell tax.
Private helper that moves balance entries between accounts and emits Transfer.
Private helper that converts accumulated contract tokens into native currency and splits it between marketing, liquidity and the dividend tracker.
Private helper that approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap V2 router.
Private helper that adds token/ETH liquidity to the Uniswap V2 pair.
ERC20 transfer entrypoint forwarding to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint that spends allowance and forwards to _transfer.
ERC20 approve entrypoint setting allowance for msg.sender.
Owner-only flag that enables public trading by setting isOpen.
Public entrypoint that triggers dividend processing for the caller through the dividend tracker.
Public entrypoint that compounds the caller's dividends back into tokens.
Owner-only rescue of arbitrary ERC20 tokens to the owner.
Owner-only rescue of native currency to the owner.
Owner-only setter that overwrites treasury, liquidity and dividend fee BPS and recomputes totalFeeBPS.
Owner-only router replacement that also creates a new pair.
Owner-only addition of an address to the blacklist.
Owner-only setter for marketing and liquidity wallets.
Owner-only toggle of AMM pair classification.
Owner-only passthrough to the dividend tracker manual dividend send.
Owner-only passthrough to exclude an account from dividends.
Owner-only toggle of the automatic swap feature.
Owner-only update of swap toggle, swap threshold and swap-all flag.
Owner-only setter of the max transaction size in basis points.
Owner-only setter of the max wallet size in basis points.
Owner-only toggle of the fee exclusion mapping.
Owner-only toggle of max transaction exemption.
Owner-only toggle of max wallet exemption.
Payable function that magnifies incoming ETH into magnifiedDividendPerShare and books total distributed dividends.
Private routine that computes withdrawable dividends and forwards them with a low level call.
Owner-gated function that withdraws dividends for an account and stamps the claim timestamp.
Private routine that swaps accrued ETH dividends into the tracked token for the account.
Owner-gated function that compounds dividends for an account and stamps the claim timestamp.
Owner-only function that pushes native currency to an arbitrary holder.
Owner-only balance synchronisation that mints or burns tracker shares.
Owner-only toggle of dividend exclusion which forces a balance reset.
Internal tracker mint that also adjusts magnified dividend corrections.
Internal tracker burn that also adjusts magnified dividend corrections.
View of accrued minus already withdrawn dividends.
View computing accumulated dividends from magnified per-share value and signed corrections.
Fallback receive hook that routes incoming ETH into distributeDividends.
Low level value call from _executeSwap to the dividend tracker address using forwardAll gas.
Low level value call to an arbitrary account with a 3000 gas stipend inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
Native .transfer to the marketing wallet inside _executeSwap.
Native .transfer to an arbitrary holder with an owner-controlled amount inside DividendTracker.manualSendDividend.
Native .transfer of arbitrary amount to msg.sender inside rescueETH.
External ERC20 transfer call to an owner-supplied token address inside rescueToken.
External Uniswap V2 router swap of tokens for ETH with zero slippage protection and block.timestamp deadline.
External Uniswap V2 router swap of ETH for tokens performed while compounding, wrapped in try/catch.
External Uniswap V2 router addLiquidityETH call with zero minimum amounts and block.timestamp deadline.
Caller-controlled address used as transfer source, allowance owner, rescue recipient and dividend account.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for swap throttling, router deadlines and last claim times.
Trading gate flag set only by openTrading.
Reentrancy guard flag set around the swap block in _transfer.
Threshold of contract tokens required to trigger a swap.
Owner-controlled flag enabling automatic swaps.
Owner-controlled flag enabling the transfer tax.
Sum of all fee components applied to taxable transfers.
Treasury/marketing fee in basis points.
Dividend fee in basis points.
Liquidity fee in basis points.
Address receiving the treasury share of native currency.
Address receiving the liquidity LP tokens.
Core ERC20 balance accounting mapping.
Allowlist that bypasses the isOpen restriction on transfers.
Blacklist that blocks senders and recipients from transferring.
Marks addresses treated as AMM pairs for tax and swap logic.
Address of the deployed DividendTracker contract, also its owner.
Router used for all swaps and liquidity operations.
Main liquidity pair for the token.
Maximum transfer size expressed in basis points of total supply.
Maximum wallet holding expressed in basis points of total supply.
Accounts exempt from the transfer tax.
Accounts exempt from the max transaction limit.
Accounts exempt from the max wallet limit.
Total token supply used as the base of the BPS limits.
Magnified cumulative dividend per tracker share, updated on every distribution.
Per-account amount of dividends already withdrawn or compounded.
Per-account timestamp of the last claim or compound.
Cumulative dividends withdrawn from the tracker.
Accounts excluded from dividend accounting.
Minimum token balance required to participate in dividends.
Signed per-account correction applied when tracker shares are minted or burned.
ERC20 allowance accounting mapping.
Owner-controlled flag enabling dividend compounding.
Selects whether the whole contract token balance or only the threshold is swapped.
Sender address argument of _transfer.
Recipient address argument of _transfer.
Amount argument of _transfer.
Local boolean deciding whether the transfer tax applies.
Local variable holding the computed tax amount.
Local snapshot of the contract token balance passed to the swap.
Payable account argument of _withdrawDividendOfUser.
Local amount of dividends to be paid out.
Owner-supplied amount transferred in manualSendDividend.
Owner-supplied recipient of the manual dividend.
New router address supplied by the owner.
Local token amount reserved for the marketing share.
Local native amount reserved for the dividend tracker.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the from-address forwarded to _transfer by transfer().
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender inside transferFrom().
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender selects the account whose dividends are processed in the public claim() function.
msg.sender selects the account compounded in the public compound() function.
rescueToken sends the rescued tokens to the caller msg.sender.
rescueETH sends the rescued native currency to the caller msg.sender.
The recipient of the external ERC20 transfer is the caller-controlled msg.sender.
block.timestamp is written to lastSwapTime inside the swap branch of _transfer, throttling swaps.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the Uniswap router.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the Uniswap router.
block.timestamp is stored in lastClaimTimes inside processAccount.
block.timestamp is stored in lastClaimTimes inside compoundAccount.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline inside _compoundDividendOfUser.
The deadline argument of the compound swap is the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
transfer() delegates all transfer logic to the internal _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer() after allowance handling.
_transfer executes the actual balance moves through _executeTransfer().
_transfer invokes _executeSwap when the contract token balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer synchronises the dividend tracker via setBalance for sender and recipient.
_executeSwap calls swapTokensForNative to convert tokens into native currency.
_executeSwap calls addLiquidity to seed the liquidity pool.
swapTokensForNative invokes the router swap for ETH support tokens.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH with the native value.
_executeSwap pays the marketing wallet with a native transfer.
_executeSwap forwards the dividend share with a low level value call to the tracker address.
claim() forwards to the onlyOwner processAccount, relying on REFLECT being the tracker owner.
compound() forwards to the onlyOwner compoundAccount, relying on REFLECT being the tracker owner.
rescueToken performs the external ERC20 transfer.
rescueETH performs the native transfer to the caller.
DividendTracker.manualSendDividend performs the native transfer to the holder.
_withdrawDividendOfUser pushes native currency to the account with a low level call.
_compoundDividendOfUser performs an external router swap while refunding to the account.
The receive hook routes incoming ETH into distributeDividends.
setBalance mints tracker shares when the new balance increases.
setBalance burns tracker shares when the new balance decreases.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser to obtain the payout amount.
compoundAccount calls _compoundDividendOfUser to obtain the compounded amounts.
withdrawableDividendOf subtracts withdrawn dividends from accumulativeDividendOf.
REFLECT.manualSendDividend forwards the call to the tracker manualSendDividend.
The low level call to an arbitrary account can re-enter the token transfer path.
The external call allows re-entering _withdrawDividendOfUser through claim or compound.
Sending ETH to the tracker triggers its receive hook and distributeDividends.
The tracker call happens while the REFLECT transfer is still in progress and can re-enter it.
The router swap interacts with the REFLECT token and can call back into transfer logic.
The swapExactTokensForETH call triggers token transfers back into REFLECT.
addLiquidityETH triggers a token transferFrom that re-enters REFLECT accounting.
The native transfer to the marketing wallet executes recipient code before _transfer finishes.
The native transfer in rescueETH sends control to the caller.
The native transfer in manualSendDividend sends control to the holder address.
setFee recomputes totalFeeBPS as the sum of the individual fee components without an upper bound.
totalFeeBPS scales the fee deducted from amount as (amount * totalFeeBPS) / 10000.
msg.value * magnitude is divided by _totalSupply when updating magnifiedDividendPerShare.
magnifiedDividendPerShare * amount is cast to int256 for the mint correction.
magnifiedDividendPerShare * amount is cast to int256 for the burn correction.
A signed correction is added to a signed magnified value then cast to uint256.
maxTxBPS scales the maximum transfer amount as (totalSupply * maxTxBPS) / 10000.
maxWalletBPS scales the maximum wallet size as (totalSupply * maxWalletBPS) / 10000.
_transfer reads and updates the _balances mapping.
_transfer consults the _whiteList mapping in the isOpen gate.
_transfer consults isBlacklisted for sender and recipient.
_transfer consults automatedMarketMakerPairs to decide fee taking and swap gating.
_transfer requires isOpen or a white-listed/owner participant.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFees to skip the tax.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromMaxTx for the transaction limit.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromMaxWallet for the wallet limit.
_transfer uses totalSupply to derive both BPS limits.
_transfer compares the contract token balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer gates the swap block on swapEnabled.
_transfer gates fee taking on taxEnabled.
_transfer uses swapAllToken to decide the swap input size.
The swapping flag is set before and cleared after the external swap sequence.
_executeTransfer mutates the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
setBalance returns early for accounts in excludedFromDividends.
excludeFromDividends writes the excludedFromDividends mapping.
_withdrawDividendOfUser updates withdrawnDividends before and after the external call.
_compoundDividendOfUser updates withdrawnDividends before and after the external swap.
withdrawableDividendOf subtracts the withdrawnDividends entry.
accumulativeDividendOf is combined with withdrawnDividends to derive payouts.
processAccount stamps lastClaimTimes with block.timestamp.
compoundAccount stamps lastClaimTimes with block.timestamp.
accumulativeDividendOf multiplies magnifiedDividendPerShare by the account balance.
The sender parameter feeds the isOpen, blacklist and balance checks of _transfer.
The recipient parameter feeds the blacklist, max-wallet and fee logic of _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated against limits and reduced by fees.
takeFee is derived inside _transfer from the AMM pair, exclusion and swap state.
fees is computed inside _transfer from amount and totalFeeBPS.
contractTokenBalance is snapshotted inside _transfer before the swap decision.
The snapshotted contract token balance is passed into _executeSwap.
The account parameter determines whose dividends are computed and paid.
_withdrawableDividend is computed inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
The owner-supplied amount parameter is forwarded into manualSendDividend.
The owner-supplied amount directly determines the native transfer size when non-zero.
The holder parameter is the recipient of the manual dividend transfer.
The new router address parameter is stored and used to create a new pair.
swapTokensMarketing is computed inside _executeSwap from the treasury fee.
nativeDividends is computed inside _executeSwap from the dividend share.
The marketing token share determines the native amount transferred to the marketing wallet.
The dividend native amount is the value sent through the low level call to the tracker.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only meaningful as an input to the _transfer logic and carries no independent semantics.
The recipient parameter is only used inside _transfer for checks and balance updates.
The amount parameter is only consumed by the _transfer limit and fee arithmetic.
takeFee is a local decision variable fully determined by _transfer conditions.
fees is a transient local computed and consumed within _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is a local snapshot used to drive the _executeSwap call.
The account parameter only exists to identify the dividend recipient inside this routine.
The withdrawable amount local is the value paid out by this routine and has no standalone meaning.
The amount parameter directly drives the native transfer operation emitted by manualSendDividend.
The holder parameter is the destination of the manual dividend transfer.
The new address parameter is only used to swap the router and recreate the pair.
The marketing token share local is a transient intermediate value of _executeSwap.
The dividend native amount local exists only to size the tracker payout inside _executeSwap.
